grammar.pattern: 动宾式离合词：对象、数量和时长
grammar.purpose: Place added material inside the separable construction
grammar.explanation: 帮忙 can expand to 帮我一个忙, 见面 to 跟朋友见一次面, 理发 to 理个发, 睡觉 to 睡了一个小时的觉. Do not attach every object after the full compound: 帮忙我 is not the intended standard request. With 结婚 use 跟/和…结婚 rather than 结婚她. The semantic object is built into the compound; duration/number placement depends on the construction, and not every two-character verb is separable.

commonMistakes.why: Place the beneficiary and quantity inside this separable verb.

grammar.pattern: 连动句：同一主语的连续动作或目的
grammar.purpose: Keep the actor and purpose clear in a request
grammar.explanation: 我去办公室复印两页 states my going and copying, with copying as the trip purpose. 她来找我讨论时间 shares one actor across linked verbs. A different actor must be stated separately. 去问时间 describes an intended task, not proof an answer was obtained; ask for the result afterward.

examples.py: wǒ qù bàn gōng shì fù yìn liǎng yè .
examples.en: I go to the office to photocopy two pages.

examples.en: She comes to find me to discuss the time.

examples.en: I contact her to ask the time and have not received an answer.

lines.zh: 麻烦你帮我一个忙，可以吗？

lines.py: xiān shuō shì shén me , wǒ xià wǔ cái yǒu kōng .

lines.py: lián xì tā wèn jiàn miàn de shí jiān , bù yòng tì wǒ dā yìng .
lines.en: Contact her to ask the meeting time; do not agree for me.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 她在理发，下午才能回消息。
lines.py: tā zài lǐ fà , xià wǔ cái néng huí xiāo xī .
lines.en: She is having a haircut and can reply only in the afternoon.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。我先去办公室复印两页，再等消息。
lines.py: hǎo . wǒ xiān qù bàn gōng shì fù yìn liǎng yè , zài děng xiāo xī .
lines.en: Okay. I will go to the office to copy two pages, then wait for a message.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 另外一位也要问吗？

lines.py: bù yòng , zhǐ wèn tā . zuì hòu bǔ chōng yī jù , shí jiān hái méi què rèn .
lines.en: No, ask only her. One final detail: the time is unconfirmed.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 明白，是帮你问，不是替所有人决定。
lines.py: míng bái , shì bāng nǐ wèn , bù shì tì suǒ yǒu rén jué dìng .

reading.title: A bounded favour
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Follow actor, object and consent in the message.

lines.zh: 请帮我一个忙，是一个请求，不是给你无限任务。
lines.py: qǐng bāng wǒ yī gè máng , shì yī gè qǐng qiú , bù shì gěi nǐ wú xiàn rèn wù .
lines.en: Please do me a favour is a request, not unlimited assignments.

lines.zh: 只联系一位朋友，问见面的时间。
lines.py: zhǐ lián xì yī wèi péng you , wèn jiàn miàn de shí jiān .
lines.en: Contact only one friend and ask the meeting time.

lines.zh: 她去理个发，下午才有空回消息。
lines.py: tā qù lǐ gè fā , xià wǔ cái yǒu kōng huí xiāo xī .
lines.en: She goes for a haircut and has time to reply only in the afternoon.

lines.zh: 我去办公室复印两页，是我做这两件事。
lines.py: wǒ qù bàn gōng shì fù yìn liǎng yè , shì wǒ zuò zhè liǎng jiàn shì .
lines.en: I go to the office to copy two pages; I perform both linked actions.

lines.zh: 麻烦你问，不是麻烦你替别人答应。
lines.py: má fan nǐ wèn , bù shì má fan nǐ tì bié ren dā yìng .
lines.en: Trouble you to ask, not to agree for someone else.

lines.zh: 先联系，再接待；亲姐妹也要问自己的安排。
lines.py: xiān lián xì , zài jiē dài ; qīn jiě mèi yě yào wèn zì jǐ de ān pái .
lines.en: Contact first, then receive guests; even biological sisters need their own plans asked.

lines.zh: 相互帮忙也允许说不方便，另外一位不用自动加入。
lines.py: xiāng hù bāng máng yě yǔn xǔ shuō bù fāng biàn , lìng wài yī wèi bù yòng zì dòng jiā rù .
lines.en: Mutual help allows saying it is inconvenient; another person need not automatically join.

lines.zh: 没收到回答就说没收到，不把建议写成确认。
lines.py: méi shōu dào huí dá jiù shuō méi shōu dào , bù bǎ jiàn yì xiě chéng què rèn .
lines.en: If no reply arrived, say so; do not record a suggestion as confirmation.

lines.py: tán huà xiān wèn tā xiàn zài fāng biàn bù fāng biàn .
lines.en: Before talking, ask whether now is convenient.

lines.zh: 谈话没结束，我先不打断。
lines.py: tán huà méi jié shù , wǒ xiān bù dǎ duàn .
lines.en: The conversation has not ended; I will not interrupt.

lines.zh: 最后补充一句，我只问时间。
lines.py: zuì hòu bǔ chōng yī jù , wǒ zhǐ wèn shí jiān .
lines.en: Add one final detail: I ask only about the time.

lines.zh: 她们是亲姐妹，不是只看起来像。
lines.py: tā men shì qīn jiě mèi , bù shì zhǐ kàn qǐ lái xiàng .
lines.en: They are biological sisters, not just similar-looking.

lines.zh: 领导不在，可以先问联系人。
lines.py: lǐng dǎo bù zài , kě yǐ xiān wèn lián xì rén .
lines.en: The leader is absent; ask the contact person first.

lines.zh: 领导不在，先问今天谁负责接待。
lines.py: lǐng dǎo bù zài , xiān wèn jīn tiān shéi fù zé jiē dài .
lines.en: The leader is absent; ask who handles reception today.

lines.zh: 交往要相互尊重，不替别人做决定。
lines.py: jiāo wǎng yào xiāng hù zūn zhòng , bù tì bié ren zuò jué dìng .
lines.en: Interaction needs mutual respect; do not decide for others.

lines.zh: 交往中有问题，可以先说明自己的需要。
lines.py: jiāo wǎng zhōng yǒu wèn tí , kě yǐ xiān shuō míng zì jǐ de xū yào .
lines.en: When problems arise in interactions, first explain one’s needs.
